_notes: Document review verb: the agency console said 批准 (approve) for 'Verify' while the resulting status everywhere is 已核实 (verified). Unified on the 核实 family (核实通过 for the button) so staff see one concept.
'Case' (visa case, service case) was 案例, which in Chinese means 'example/case study'. Rendered as 签证办理 / 服务请求 / 个案 depending on the sentence; agency:v27.stage.label (KO 진행 단계) is 办理阶段.
표준입학허가서 = 标准入学许可书 where the document is meant (agency:ws.noVisaText, university:decision.certificateInfo); status chips keep the short 入学许可书 as the English keeps 'Admission letter'. 录取通知书 was wrong.
Arrival: consoles use 入境 consistently (agency:v27.stage.ARRIVAL was 抵达, everything else 入境).
Insights: both consoles' nav say 统计; university:v28.pipe.label now points to “统计” instead of 数据分析, which was not a page name.

university:v25.head.label used 您 while every other university string uses 你/贵校; made it a neutral label (待处理事项, KO 지금 확인할 것) rather than switching the whole console to 您. Owner may prefer a console-wide 您 for the formal university product.

KEYS MISSING FROM THE zh-Hans BUNDLE (cur = null, 492 keys: the whole agency login/today/settings/team/HQ/v29-plan/v30-definition areas and most of university decision/detail/settings/SSO/stage): these render in English today, so they were translated here; apply-patch.mjs creates a missing translation when the English has the key (dry run: 541 applied, 0 refused). agency:apps.actor.HANGYUL is 'Hangyul 团队' because a bare 'Hangyul' is refused as identical to English.
Verified: every patched value keeps exactly the English {{placeholder}} set.
